Fitted ivory ankle shafts, burgundy rounded toe caps and block high heels, gold sole edge and gold fleur-de-lis ornament at upper front. Keep exact elegant ankle-boot height; these are NOT knee-high boots and not pumps. No legs, feet or skirt.
